class.name: Spreen
class.brief_description: A [Tween] like object, but the underlying animations are spring-based, using [Spreener]s.
class.description: Spreens inherit the benefits of using a [Tween] but the interpolation of values is based on springs, using half-life and dampening ratios rather than durations. A [Spreen] is created by using [method SpreenTree.create_spreen]. [Spreen]s created by using [code]Spreen.new()[/code] will not function. Values are controlled by adding [Spreener]s to the [Spreen] object using [method spreen_basis], [method spreen_float], [method spreen_transform_2d], [method spreen_transform_3d], [method spreen_vector2], and [method spreen_vector3].

method.name: bind_node
method.description: Binds this [Spreen] with the given [param node]. [Spreen]s are processed by a singleton [SpreenTree], so they run independently of the animated nodes. When you bind a [Node] with the [Spreen], the [Spreen] will halt the animation when the object is not inside tree and the [Spreen] will be automatically killed when the bound object is freed. Also [constant SPREEN_PAUSE_BOUND] will make the pausing behavior dependent on the bound node.

method.name: custom_step
method.description: Processes the [Spreen] by the given [param delta] value, in seconds. This is mostly useful for manual control when the [Spreen] is paused. Returns [code]true[/code] if the [Spreen] still has [Spreener]s that haven't finished.

method.name: get_bound_node
method.description: Returns the [Node] the [Spreen] is bound to.

method.name: get_total_elapsed_time
method.description: Returns the total time in seconds the [Spreen] has been animating (i.e. the time since it started, not counting pauses etc.).

method.name: is_dead
method.description: Returns if the [Spreen] is currently dead, because it has finished or is no longer valid.

method.name: is_finishable
method.description: Returns if the [Spreen] will finish and emit a [signal finished] signal, or if it will continue to process forever (useful for controllers).

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns if all the [Spreener]s have reported finished and have reached their goal.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns whether the [Spreen] is currently running, i.e. it wasn't paused and it's not finished.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the [Spreen] is valid. A valid [Spreen] is a [Spreen] contained by the [SpreenTree]. A [Spreen] might become invalid when it has finished tweening, is killed, or when created with [code]Spreen.new()[/code]. Invalid [Spreen]s can't have [Spreener]s appended.

method.name: kill
method.description: Aborts all tweening operations and invalidates the [Spreen].

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses the tweening. The animation can be resumed by using [method play]. [b]Note:[/b] If a Tween is paused and not bound to any node, it will exist indefinitely until manually started or invalidated.

method.name: play
method.description: Resumes a paused or stopped [Spreen].

method.name: set_finishable
method.description: Sets the finishable flag on the [Spreen] which allows the [Spreener]s attached to finish, and the [Spreen] will emit a [signal finished] signal when all goals have been met.

method.name: set_pause_mode
method.description: Determines the behavior of the [Spreen] when the [SceneTree] is paused. Default value is [constant SPREEN_PAUSE_BOUND].

method.name: set_process_mode
method.description: Determines whether the [Spreen] should run after process frames (see [method Node._process]) or physics frames (see [method Node._physics_process]). Default value is [constant SPREEN_PROCESS_IDLE].

method.name: spreen_basis
method.description: Creates and appends a [BasisSpreener]. This method tweens a [param property] of an [param object] between the property's value and [param goal] using a spring with [param damping_ratio] and [param halflife], in seconds. [b]Note:[/b] For a critically damped spring, use a damping_ratio of [code]1.0[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] For more examples of these values, see [url=https://theorangeduck.com/page/spring-roll-call]the original blog post[/url] this class was inspired by.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the tweening and resets the [Spreen] to its initial state. This will not remove any appended [Spreener]s.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when the [Spreen] has finished all tweening. Never emitted when the [Spreen] is not set to finishable (see [method set_finishable]).

constants.constant: The [Spreen] updates after each physics frame (see [method Node._physics_process]).
The [Spreen] updates after each process frame (see [method Node._process]).
If the [Spreen] has a bound node, it will process when that node can process (see [member Node.process_mode]). Otherwise it's the same as [constant SPREEN_PAUSE_STOP].
If [SceneTree] is paused, the [Spreen] will also pause.
The [Spreen] will process regardless of whether [SceneTree] is paused.
